items.title: 8.4.2 Key Principles of Research Ethics (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the principles of research ethics (PDF 201).

items: Informed consent: shurakaa ko maqsad bata kar shamil karne se pehle ijazat lena.
Confidentiality: shurakaa ki zaati maloomat aur jawab raaz rakhna.
Integrity: diyanatdar aur shaffaf rehna; kabhi data ghadna, plagiarism ya nataij ghalat pesh na karna.
Respect for participants: izzat se pesh aana aur yaqeeni banana ke research unhein nuqsan na de.
Bias se bachao: munsifana kaam aur nateeje saboot par.

blocks.alt: Oopar: teeron se jure chhe qadam, question, hypothesis, find sources, evaluate, organize aur report, har ek chhote note ke saath. Neeche baen: research ethics ke paanch usool ek ek line ke maani ke saath. Neeche daen: patent, trademark, copyright, industrial design aur trade secret ki table, har ek kya bachata hai aur kitab ki misal.
blocks.caption: Research ke qadam, research ethics aur intellectual property (topics 8.2 se 8.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Research project wazeh sawal se qabil-e-aazmaish hypothesis, phir libraries aur databases mein maakhaz dhoondne, unhein parakhne (maslan kya peer-reviewed hain), notes aur files munazzam karne, aur har maakhaz ke hawale ke saath nataij batane tak jata hai. Akhlaqi research shurakaa ki soch samajh kar raza leti, un ke jawab raaz rakhti, kabhi jaali data ya plagiarism nahi karti, nuqsan se bachti aur faisla saboot par chhorti hai, tarafdari par nahi. Intellectual property ijadat ko patents, brands ko trademarks, takhleeqi kaam ko copyright, product ki shakal ko industrial designs aur raazdarana maharat ko trade secrets se bachati hai.

blocks.prompt: Akhlaqi research ke liye kya zaroori hai (MCQ 7)? Kaunsa usool sachi reporting ka hai (MCQ 8)? Researcher bias se kaise bache (short question 6)?
blocks.explanation: (b) plagiarism se bachna aur durust credit dena; (b) integrity. Bias se bachne ke liye: data se pehle sawal aur tareeqa tay karein, munsifana namoone lein, ghair mutawaqqo samait tamam nataij darj karein, doosri tehqeeq se milayein aur nateeje zaati raye ki bajaye saboot se banne dein.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: aisa case parhein jahan ethics nazar-andaz hui, jaise shurakaa ki privacy ka khayal na rakhne wali tehqeeq. Kya ghalat hua aur akhlaqi tareeqa kya hota?
blocks.explanation: Aam taur par zaati data baghair raza jama ya share hua; maqsad batana, ijazat lena, data se naam hatana aur mehfooz rakhna chahiye tha.

items: Usool: informed consent, confidentiality, integrity, respect, bias se bachao.
